title: Zesty Herbal Algerian Fish Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic Algerian dish featuring fish cooked in a zesty herbal sauce, perfect for a crowd, this recipe is low in glycemic index and can be served in a tagine vessel.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped parsley and cilantro to the oil and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pot and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cod fish pieces to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the fish sauce and lemon juice until well combined.
Pour the fish sauce mixture over the fish and herbs in the tagine vessel.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Cover the tagine vessel with a lid and cook over low heat for 10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Serve the Zesty Herbal Algerian Fish Tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley and cilantro if desired.
